description: Module Health Scorecard weights. Default mode is ado_only (bugs + PFRs). Revenue optional via --with-revenue.

insights.text: High PFR demand relative to revenue — investment candidate.
Strong revenue but elevated bug load — maintenance / quality debt risk.
Broad customer PFR backlog — prioritise grooming and Impacted Module hygiene.
Low activity signal — confirm module is in active portfolio or legacy.

insights_ado_only.text: Elevated bug volume — review triage, regressions, and release readiness.
Strong open PFR demand from multiple customers — prioritise backlog review.
Quality debt plus customer demand — module under combined pressure.
Broad customer PFR backlog — prioritise grooming and Impacted Module hygiene.
Multiple P1 bugs in 90 days — escalate stability review.
